zoe_cs: Stratagem finished onboarding smoke tests — during a partner load run (~900 rps) they hit intermittent 502/503 from eu-west. Ask: temporary regional QPS increase + allowlist for partner NetEdge. Demo scheduled Fri 11:00 UTC; renewal in 18 days. Can ops/prov handle a 48h timeboxed bump?

rachid_ops: Copy. Need NetEdge CIDRs and exact targets. Also confirm demo timezone.

zoe_cs: CIDRs: 198.18.0.0/24 and 2001:db8:feed::/48. Request: eu-west -> 1250 qps, us-west fallback -> 250 qps, ttl 48h. Demo Fri 11:00 UTC.

noel_sre: I'll create a transient allowlist and a timeboxed rate window. Plan: pin to low-latency quant model during demo, enable KV-cache prewarm 25m prior, and add route-level tracing. Will set autorevoke at 48h.

infra-bot: Provision job 2026-04-02_02:45 initiated by noel_sre; route created eu-west-stratagem-burst-1749954321

rachid_ops: please apply now so AM can confirm. I'll standby on-call for demo window.

noel_sre: Applied. Internal API snippet used: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/provision -d '{"cidrs":["198.18.0.0/24","2001:db8:feed::/48"],"regions":{"eu-west":1250,"us-west":250},"ttl":172800}'

noel_sre: Done. Autorevoke epoch UTC: 1750120721. Audit link: /internal/logs/provision/1749954321.txt. Route pinned to small-quant-2; KV warmup scheduled T-25m. Fallback policy active to keep p95 token latency <120ms.

talia_account: Logged renewal risk and scheduled post-demo enablement: 1:1 walkthrough + 7-day usage check. We'll collect feedback on peering and latency variance.

zoe_cs: Great — I'll send prep notes and feedback form to customer. If demo goes well propose a short Dedicated pilot to lock capacity. Thanks all :sparkles:
